WITH case_env AS (
  SELECT 
    e.case_link,
    AVG(e.tempVar24) as avg_temp_var,
    AVG(e.RHvar) as avg_rh_var
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
  WHERE e.tempVar24 IS NOT NULL AND e.RHvar IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.case_link
),
case_leak AS (
  SELECT 
    s."caseID",
    (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::float as leak_rate
  FROM "Showcases" s
),
se_score AS (
  SELECT 
    cl."caseID",
    10 - ((ce.avg_temp_var + (ce.avg_rh_var / 5.0) + cl.leak_rate) / 3.0) as sesr
  FROM case_leak cl
  JOIN case_env ce ON ce.case_link = cl."caseID"
),
maint_critical AS (
  SELECT 
    s."caseID",
    CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as critical_count
  FROM "Showcases" s
)

FROM "Showcases" sc
JOIN se_score ss ON ss."caseID" = sc."caseID"
LEFT JOIN maint_critical mc ON mc."caseID" = sc."caseID"
